passages.original: Qui hunc librum anno 1535 typis Frobenianis edi curaverunt, vix illum e prelo subduxerant, cum com- pererunt illum non novum Hilarii opus, sed rhapsodiam esse studiosi cujuspiam, tum e secundo libro de Trini- tate, tum maxime ex nono consarcinatam, cui aliunde adtexta est appendix de variis Christi cognominibus. Hoec porro appendix descripta est ex cap. 6 libri de fide orthodoxa, apud Ambrosium et apud Gregorium Naz. vulgati, quem Gregorii Boetici esse plurimi arbi- trantur. Ex eodem additamento conficitur sermo in ap- pendice Augustini nunc 113.
passages.english: Those who saw to the publication of this book in 1535 with the Froben press had scarcely taken it off the press when they discovered that it was not a new work of Hilary, but a rhapsody [i.e. a compilation] of some student, stitched together partly from the second book On the Trinity and above all from the ninth, to which an appendix on the various titles of Christ was attached from elsewhere. This appendix, moreover, was copied from chapter 6 of the book On the Orthodox Faith, published under the names of Ambrose and of Gregory Nazianzen, which very many judge to be by Gregory of Baetica [i.e. Gregory of Elvira]. From the same addition is composed the sermon now numbered 113 in the appendix of Augustine.
passages.notes: 'Hoec' read as 'Haec' (scanning error). 'Gregorii Boetici' taken as 'Baetici', i.e. Gregory of Elvira in Baetica. This is an editorial preface, not Hilary's own text.
